title: A C¹ hypercone of A₀ whose unit normal has zero tangential derivative is a punctured m-plane (parent step 10)
statement: Flat cones are planes. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; a linear subspace A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P; M ⊆ ℝ^P; ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P. Hypotheses: m ≥ 2; dim A₀ = m + 1; M ≠ ∅; M ⊆ A₀; 0 ∉ M; M is an embedded C¹ m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M); closure(M) ⊆ M ∪ {0}; tx ∈ M for every x ∈ M and t > 0; ν is differentiable at every x ∈ M; for every x ∈ M, ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x; and Dν(x)v = 0 (fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0) for every x ∈ M and v ∈ tangentSpace M x. Conclusion: there is a linear subspace H₀ ⊆ ℝ^P with dim H₀ = m (Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m) and M = H₀ ∖ {0}.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), 2 ≤ m → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M.Nonempty → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 m M → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∀ x ∈ M, DifferentiableAt ℝ ν x) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0) → ∃ H₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ H₀ = m ∧ M = (H₀ : Set (Euclid P)) \ {0}
